The clean reference is the pre-bug compiled build at /app/dist/index.mjs (readable, prettier-formatted, NOT minified). The bug is likely one of: off-by-one, sign flip, swapped variables, wrong cache key, missing reset/clear, shared mutable state between instances, wrong coordinate offset (top/left), or a missing `this.`.

2	import type { XY } from '../../Point';
3	import { Point } from '../../Point';
4	import type { TDegree, TRadian, TMat2D } from '../../typedefs';
5	import { cos } from './cos';
6	import { degreesToRadians, radiansToDegrees } from './radiansDegreesConversion';
7	import { sin } from './sin';
8	
9	export type TRotateMatrixArgs = {
10	  angle?: TDegree;
11	};
12	
13	export type TTranslateMatrixArgs = {
14	  translateX?: number;
15	  translateY?: number;
16	};
17	
18	export type TScaleMatrixArgs = {
19	  scaleX?: number;
20	  scaleY?: number;
21	  flipX?: boolean;
22	  flipY?: boolean;
23	  skewX?: TDegree;
24	  skewY?: TDegree;
25	};
26	
27	export type TComposeMatrixArgs = TTranslateMatrixArgs &
28	  TRotateMatrixArgs &
29	  TScaleMatrixArgs;
30	
31	export type TQrDecomposeOut = Required<
32	  Omit<TComposeMatrixArgs, 'flipX' | 'flipY'>
33	>;
34	
35	export const isIdentityMatrix = (mat: TMat2D) =>
36	  mat.every((value, index) => value === iMatrix[index]);
37	
38	/**
39	 * Apply transform t to point p
40	 * @deprecated use {@link Point#transform}
41	 * @param  {Point | XY} p The point to transform
42	 * @param  {Array} t The transform
43	 * @param  {Boolean} [ignoreOffset] Indicates that the offset should not be applied
44	 * @return {Point} The transformed point
45	 */
46	export const transformPoint = (
47	  p: XY,
48	  t: TMat2D,
49	  ignoreOffset?: boolean,
50	): Point => new Point(p).transform(t, ignoreOffset);
51	
52	/**
53	 * Invert transformation t
54	 * @param {Array} t The transform
55	 * @return {Array} The inverted transform
56	 */
57	export const invertTransform = (t: TMat2D): TMat2D => {
58	  const a = 1 / (t[0] * t[3] - t[1] * t[2]),
59	    r = [a * t[3], -a * t[1], -a * t[2], a * t[0], 0, 0] as TMat2D,
60	    { x, y } = new Point(t[4], t[5]).transform(r, true);
61	  r[4] = -x;
62	  r[5] = -y;
63	  return r;
64	};
65	
66	/**
67	 * Multiply matrix A by matrix B to nest transformations
68	 * @param  {TMat2D} a First transformMatrix
69	 * @param  {TMat2D} b Second transformMatrix
70	 * @param  {Boolean} is2x2 flag to multiply matrices as 2x2 matrices
71	 * @return {TMat2D} The product of the two transform matrices
72	 */
73	export const multiplyTransformMatrices = (
74	  a: TMat2D,
75	  b: TMat2D,
76	  is2x2?: boolean,
77	): TMat2D =>
78	  [
79	    a[0] * b[0] + a[2] * b[1],
80	    a[1] * b[0] + a[3] * b[1],
81	    a[0] * b[2] + a[2] * b[3],
82	    a[1] * b[2] + a[3] * b[3],
83	    is2x2 ? 0 : a[0] * b[4] + a[2] * b[5] + a[4],
84	    is2x2 ? 0 : a[1] * b[4] + a[3] * b[5] + a[5],
85	  ] as TMat2D;
86	
87	/**
88	 * Multiplies the matrices array such that a matrix defines the plane for the rest of the matrices **after** it
89	 *
90	 * `multiplyTransformMatrixArray([A, B, C, D])` is equivalent to `A(B(C(D)))`
91	 *
92	 * @param matrices an array of matrices
93	 * @param [is2x2] flag to multiply matrices as 2x2 matrices
94	 * @returns the multiplication product
95	 */
96	export const multiplyTransformMatrixArray = (
97	  matrices: (TMat2D | undefined | null | false)[],
98	  is2x2?: boolean,
99	) =>
100	  matrices.reduceRight(
101	    (product: TMat2D, curr) =>
102	      curr && product
103	        ? multiplyTransformMatrices(curr, product, is2x2)
104	        : curr || product,
105	    undefined as unknown as TMat2D,
106	  ) || iMatrix.concat();
107	
108	export const calcPlaneRotation = ([a, b]: TMat2D) =>
109	  Math.atan2(b, a) as TRadian;
110	
111	/**
112	 * Decomposes standard 2x3 matrix into transform components
113	 * @param  {TMat2D} a transformMatrix
114	 * @return {Object} Components of transform
115	 */
116	export const qrDecompose = (a: TMat2D): TQrDecomposeOut => {
117	  const angle = calcPlaneRotation(a),
118	    denom = Math.pow(a[0], 2) + Math.pow(a[1], 2),
119	    scaleX = Math.sqrt(denom),
120	    scaleY = (a[0] * a[3] - a[2] * a[1]) / scaleX,
121	    skewX = Math.atan2(a[0] * a[2] + a[1] * a[3], denom);
122	  return {
123	    angle: radiansToDegrees(angle),
124	    scaleX,
125	    scaleY,
126	    skewX: radiansToDegrees(skewX),
127	    skewY: 0 as TDegree,
128	    translateX: a[4] || 0,
129	    translateY: a[5] || 0,
130	  };
131	};
132	
133	/**
134	 * Generate a translation matrix
135	 *
136	 * A translation matrix in the form of
137	 * [ 1 0 x ]
138	 * [ 0 1 y ]
139	 * [ 0 0 1 ]
140	 *
141	 * See {@link https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/SVG/Attribute/transform#translate} for more details
142	 *
143	 * @param {number} x translation on X axis
144	 * @param {number} [y] translation on Y axis
145	 * @returns {TMat2D} matrix
146	 */
147	export const createTranslateMatrix = (x: number, y = 0): TMat2D => [
148	  1,
149	  0,
150	  0,
151	  1,
152	  x,
153	  y,
154	];
155	
156	/**
157	 * Generate a rotation matrix around around a point (x,y), defaulting to (0,0)
158	 *
159	 * A matrix in the form of
160	 * [cos(a) -sin(a) -x*cos(a)+y*sin(a)+x]
161	 * [sin(a)  cos(a) -x*sin(a)-y*cos(a)+y]
162	 * [0       0      1                 ]
163	 *
164	 *
165	 * @param {TDegree} angle rotation in degrees
166	 * @param {XY} [pivotPoint] pivot point to rotate around
167	 * @returns {TMat2D} matrix
168	 */
169	export function createRotateMatrix(
170	  { angle = 0 }: TRotateMatrixArgs = {},
171	  { x = 0, y = 0 }: Partial<XY> = {},
172	): TMat2D {
173	  const angleRadiant = degreesToRadians(angle),
174	    cosValue = cos(angleRadiant),
175	    sinValue = sin(angleRadiant);
176	  return [
177	    cosValue,
178	    sinValue,
179	    -sinValue,
180	    cosValue,
181	    x ? x - (cosValue * x - sinValue * y) : 0,
182	    y ? y - (sinValue * x + cosValue * y) : 0,
183	  ];
184	}
185	
186	/**
187	 * Generate a scale matrix around the point (0,0)
188	 *
189	 * A matrix in the form of
190	 * [x 0 0]
191	 * [0 y 0]
192	 * [0 0 1]
193	 *
194	 * {@link https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/SVG/Attribute/transform#scale}
195	 *
196	 * @param {number} x scale on X axis
197	 * @param {number} [y] scale on Y axis
198	 * @returns {TMat2D} matrix
199	 */
200	export const createScaleMatrix = (x: number, y: number = x): TMat2D => [
201	  x,
202	  0,
203	  0,
204	  y,
205	  0,
206	  0,
207	];
208	
209	export const angleToSkew = (angle: TDegree) =>
210	  Math.tan(degreesToRadians(angle));
211	
212	export const skewToAngle = (value: TRadian) =>
213	  radiansToDegrees(Math.atan(value));
214	
215	/**
216	 * Generate a skew matrix for the X axis
217	 *
218	 * A matrix in the form of
219	 * [1 x 0]
220	 * [0 1 0]
221	 * [0 0 1]
222	 *
223	 * {@link https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/SVG/Attribute/transform#skewx}
224	 *
225	 * @param {TDegree} skewValue translation on X axis
226	 * @returns {TMat2D} matrix
227	 */
228	export const createSkewXMatrix = (skewValue: TDegree): TMat2D => [
229	  1,
230	  0,
231	  angleToSkew(skewValue),
232	  1,
233	  0,
234	  0,
235	];
236	
237	/**
238	 * Generate a skew matrix for the Y axis
239	 *
240	 * A matrix in the form of
241	 * [1 0 0]
242	 * [y 1 0]
243	 * [0 0 1]
244	 *
245	 * {@link https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/SVG/Attribute/transform#skewy}
246	 *
247	 * @param {TDegree} skewValue translation on Y axis
248	 * @returns {TMat2D} matrix
249	 */
250	export const createSkewYMatrix = (skewValue: TDegree): TMat2D => [
251	  1,
252	  angleToSkew(skewValue),
253	  0,
254	  1,
255	  0,
256	  0,
257	];
258	
259	/**
260	 * Returns a transform matrix starting from an object of the same kind of
261	 * the one returned from qrDecompose, useful also if you want to calculate some
262	 * transformations from an object that is not enlived yet.
263	 * is called DimensionsTransformMatrix because those properties are the one that influence
264	 * the size of the resulting box of the object.
265	 * @param  {Object} options
266	 * @param  {Number} [options.scaleX]
267	 * @param  {Number} [options.scaleY]
268	 * @param  {Boolean} [options.flipX]
269	 * @param  {Boolean} [options.flipY]
270	 * @param  {Number} [options.skewX]
271	 * @param  {Number} [options.skewY]
272	 * @return {Number[]} transform matrix
273	 */
274	export const calcDimensionsMatrix = ({
275	  scaleX = 1,
276	  scaleY = 1,
277	  flipX = false,
278	  flipY = false,
279	  skewX = 0 as TDegree,
280	  skewY = 0 as TDegree,
281	}: TScaleMatrixArgs) => {
282	  let matrix = createScaleMatrix(
283	    flipX ? -scaleX : scaleX,
284	    flipY ? -scaleY : scaleY,
285	  );
286	  if (skewX) {
287	    matrix = multiplyTransformMatrices(matrix, createSkewXMatrix(skewX), true);
288	  }
289	  if (skewY) {
290	    matrix = multiplyTransformMatrices(matrix, createSkewYMatrix(skewY), true);
291	  }
292	  return matrix;
293	};
294	
295	/**
296	 * Returns a transform matrix starting from an object of the same kind of
297	 * the one returned from qrDecompose, useful also if you want to calculate some
298	 * transformations from an object that is not enlived yet
299	 * Before changing this function look at: src/benchmarks/calcTransformMatrix.mjs
300	 * @param  {Object} options
301	 * @param  {Number} [options.angle]
302	 * @param  {Number} [options.scaleX]
303	 * @param  {Number} [options.scaleY]
304	 * @param  {Boolean} [options.flipX]
305	 * @param  {Boolean} [options.flipY]
306	 * @param  {Number} [options.skewX]
307	 * @param  {Number} [options.skewY]
308	 * @param  {Number} [options.translateX]
309	 * @param  {Number} [options.translateY]
310	 * @return {Number[]} transform matrix
311	 */
312	export const composeMatrix = (options: TComposeMatrixArgs): TMat2D => {
313	  const { translateX = 0, translateY = 0, angle = 0 as TDegree } = options;
314	  let matrix = createTranslateMatrix(translateX, translateY);
315	  if (angle) {
316	    matrix = multiplyTransformMatrices(matrix, createRotateMatrix({ angle }));
317	  }
318	  const scaleMatrix = calcDimensionsMatrix(options);
319	  if (!isIdentityMatrix(scaleMatrix)) {
320	    matrix = multiplyTransformMatrices(matrix, scaleMatrix);
321	  }
322	  return matrix;
323	};

2	import { Point } from '../../Point';
3	import type { TRadian } from '../../typedefs';
4	
5	const unitVectorX = new Point(1, 0);
6	const zero = new Point();
7	
8	/**
9	 * Rotates `vector` with `radians`
10	 * @param {Point} vector The vector to rotate (x and y)
11	 * @param {Number} radians The radians of the angle for the rotation
12	 * @return {Point} The new rotated point
13	 */
14	export const rotateVector = (vector: Point, radians: TRadian) =>
15	  vector.rotate(radians);
16	
17	/**
18	 * Creates a vector from points represented as a point
19	 *
20	 * @param {Point} from
21	 * @param {Point} to
22	 * @returns {Point} vector
23	 */
24	export const createVector = (from: XY, to: XY): Point =>
25	  new Point(to).subtract(from);
26	
27	/**
28	 * return the magnitude of a vector
29	 * @return {number}
30	 */
31	export const magnitude = (point: Point) => point.distanceFrom(zero);
32	
33	/**
34	 * Calculates the angle between 2 vectors
35	 * @param {Point} a
36	 * @param {Point} b
37	 * @returns the angle in radians from `a` to `b`
38	 */
39	export const calcAngleBetweenVectors = (a: Point, b: Point): TRadian =>
40	  Math.atan2(crossProduct(a, b), dotProduct(a, b)) as TRadian;
41	
42	/**
43	 * Calculates the angle between the x axis and the vector
44	 * @param {Point} v
45	 * @returns the angle in radians of `v`
46	 */
47	export const calcVectorRotation = (v: Point) =>
48	  calcAngleBetweenVectors(unitVectorX, v);
49	
50	/**
51	 * @param {Point} v
52	 * @returns {Point} vector representing the unit vector pointing to the direction of `v`
53	 */
54	export const getUnitVector = (v: Point): Point =>
55	  v.eq(zero) ? v : v.scalarDivide(magnitude(v));
56	
57	/**
58	 * @param {Point} v
59	 * @param {Boolean} [counterClockwise] the direction of the orthogonal vector, defaults to `true`
60	 * @returns {Point} the unit orthogonal vector
61	 */
62	export const getOrthonormalVector = (
63	  v: Point,
64	  counterClockwise = true,
65	): Point =>
66	  getUnitVector(new Point(-v.y, v.x).scalarMultiply(counterClockwise ? 1 : -1));
67	
68	/**
69	 * Cross product of two vectors in 2D
70	 * @param {Point} a
71	 * @param {Point} b
72	 * @returns {number} the magnitude of Z vector
73	 */
74	export const crossProduct = (a: Point, b: Point): number =>
75	  a.x * b.y - a.y * b.x;
76	
77	/**
78	 * Dot product of two vectors in 2D
79	 * @param {Point} a
80	 * @param {Point} b
81	 * @returns {number}
82	 */
83	export const dotProduct = (a: Point, b: Point): number => a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y;
84	
85	/**
86	 * Checks if the vector is between two others. It is considered
87	 * to be inside when the vector to be tested is between the
88	 * initial vector and the final vector (included) in a counterclockwise direction.
89	 * @param {Point} t vector to be tested
90	 * @param {Point} a initial vector
91	 * @param {Point} b final vector
92	 * @returns {boolean} true if the vector is among the others
93	 */
94	export const isBetweenVectors = (t: Point, a: Point, b: Point): boolean => {
95	  if (t.eq(a) || t.eq(b)) return true;
96	  const AxB = crossProduct(a, b),
97	    AxT = crossProduct(a, t),
98	    BxT = crossProduct(b, t);
99	  return AxB >= 0 ? AxT >= 0 && BxT <= 0 : !(AxT <= 0 && BxT >= 0);
100	};

1	import { Point } from '../../Point';
2	import { CENTER } from '../../constants';
3	import type { FabricObject } from '../../shapes/Object/Object';
4	import type { TMat2D } from '../../typedefs';
5	import { makeBoundingBoxFromPoints } from './boundingBoxFromPoints';
6	import {
7	  invertTransform,
8	  multiplyTransformMatrices,
9	  qrDecompose,
10	} from './matrix';
11	
12	/**
13	 * given an object and a transform, apply the inverse transform to the object,
14	 * this is equivalent to remove from that object that transformation, so that
15	 * added in a space with the removed transform, the object will be the same as before.
16	 * Removing from an object a transform that scale by 2 is like scaling it by 1/2.
17	 * Removing from an object a transform that rotate by 30deg is like rotating by 30deg
18	 * in the opposite direction.
19	 * This util is used to add objects inside transformed groups or nested groups.
20	 * @param {FabricObject} object the object you want to transform
21	 * @param {TMat2D} transform the destination transform
22	 */
23	export const removeTransformFromObject = (
24	  object: FabricObject,
25	  transform: TMat2D,
26	) => {
27	  const inverted = invertTransform(transform),
28	    finalTransform = multiplyTransformMatrices(
29	      inverted,
30	      object.calcOwnMatrix(),
31	    );
32	  applyTransformToObject(object, finalTransform);
33	};
34	
35	/**
36	 * given an object and a transform, apply the transform to the object.
37	 * this is equivalent to change the space where the object is drawn.
38	 * Adding to an object a transform that scale by 2 is like scaling it by 2.
39	 * This is used when removing an object from an active selection for example.
40	 * @param {FabricObject} object the object you want to transform
41	 * @param {Array} transform the destination transform
42	 */
43	export const addTransformToObject = (object: FabricObject, transform: TMat2D) =>
44	  applyTransformToObject(
45	    object,
46	    multiplyTransformMatrices(transform, object.calcOwnMatrix()),
47	  );
48	
49	/**
50	 * discard an object transform state and apply the one from the matrix.
51	 * @param {FabricObject} object the object you want to transform
52	 * @param {Array} transform the destination transform
53	 */
54	export const applyTransformToObject = (
55	  object: FabricObject,
56	  transform: TMat2D,
57	) => {
58	  const { translateX, translateY, scaleX, scaleY, ...otherOptions } =
59	      qrDecompose(transform),
60	    center = new Point(translateX, translateY);
61	  object.flipX = false;
62	  object.flipY = false;
63	  Object.assign(object, otherOptions);
64	  object.set({ scaleX, scaleY });
65	  object.setPositionByOrigin(center, CENTER, CENTER);
66	};
